verdict.rationale: Shopify POS processes card payments, so chargeback and dispute handling is a fair axis for this product. However, the evidence pack never mentions disputes, dispute deadlines, dispute webhooks, or drafting evidence responses. The only related item is that POS UI extensions can query the GraphQL Admin API, which is a developer building block rather than a dispute-monitoring capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor dispute deadlines via API or webhooks and draft evidence responses for my review
